# Lefff verb lemma derivative

`french-verb-lemmas.json` is a modified, reduced linguistic resource derived
on 2026-08-22 from `french-verbs-lefff` 3.4.0's `conjugations.json`. DualSub
retains only the 7,820 attested infinitive keys whose `W` (infinitive) row
contains that key; all conjugated forms and tables were removed.

The source package is maintained by the RosaeNLG project and derives its data
from Lefff 3.4 by Benoît Sagot and contributors. The derived lemma resource
remains under the Lesser General Public License for Linguistic Resources,
included as `LICENSE-LGPLLR` in this directory.

Source package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/french-verbs-lefff/v/3.4.0
